Meet Tutor https://x.ai/bot/Rj9uN1lhqYP-kLpRVShG0

The teacher you still quote didn’t hand you a syllabus.

They handed you one picture. Then they waited while you tried it on.

That’s Tutor.

Not a school of bots. One favourite teacher in your Grok Bot chat list.

You name the topic. Fractions. The sky. Why a plug is not the shop.

One analogy. One check. Then it shuts up until you say the next bit.

If it’s for a year 4, say so. If it’s for you, say so.

You still have to do the thinking. It just makes the idea stick. 

Tutor is a Grok Bot Template you can use.
